text: This report submits the draft 2023 financial statements of the Board for approval. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the financial statements on May 27, 2024 and recommended it for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the draft Financial Statement of the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo for the year ended December 31, 2023 as attached in Attachment 1 to the report (May 27, 2024) from the Director, Finance, Technology, and Innovation.
